result.title: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
result.summary: Audio-video (AV) deepfakes can fake the face, the voice, or both. Most benchmarks only ask whether a clip is real or fake, so they cannot show whether a detector relies on the picture, the voice, or encoding traces. We present MOZAIC, a paired benchmark with a 4-way label in which every source clip is released in all four combinations of real or fake video and real or fake audio so each modality contribution can be measured directly. Fakes cover inner-face swapping, whole-frame video diffusion and voice conversion. MOZAIC has 137,745 clips from 15,014 source pairs and four tasks: T1 AV authenticity, T2 manipulation type, T3 identity verification and T4 explanation. We evaluate 12 AV multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), train four detectors and fine-tune MLLMs with LoRA. Overall, the best MLLM reaches only 35.6% on the four-way T1 and catches far more video-only fakes than voice-only fakes (43.6% vs 7.5%). Trained detectors reach 98.4% on T1, and LoRA fine-tuning raises explanation scores (OmniVinci 4.17 to 7.40, Qwen2.5-Omni 4.42 to 6.98), but the best T1 detector falls to 78.3% when the face-swap generator is held out of training, so generalization and explanation remain open. We release the dataset, the compact MOZAIC-SMALL split, the code and the prompts. https://vectorinstitute.github.io/mozaic/

AI.brief_summary: 构建音视频深度伪造基准 MOZAIC：每条源片段同时给出视频真/假与音频真/假四种配对，含四类任务，评测 12 个 MLLM 与训练检测器，发现模型明显偏重视频线索且跨生成器泛化与解释仍困难。
AI.relevance_reason: 其配对四分类设计可直接度量模型究竟依赖画面、声音还是编码痕迹，可供核查 VLM 是否走视觉旁路、内部状态是否携带真实视觉证据时借鉴；但任务本身是伪造检测，未涉及 latent 推理状态生成。
